name: D: mature, grounded narrator
reference_text: 事实和判断，是两件不同的事。你可以不同意我的看法，但我们得先确认，讨论的是不是同一个问题。有些话要说得坚定，有些疑问，也应该留一点余地。把话说清楚，再慢慢往下谈。
identity_target: Mature male voice with a low register, a little grain, and a warm, grounded presence. Conversational rather than a newsreader.
identity_design_instruction: Originally designed as a Mandarin-speaking man around fifty: a low, warm voice with a little natural grain and an actor’s presence. Clear articulation, connected thoughts, natural emphasis, and an unhurried conversational pace. Avoid an exaggerated announcer delivery, whispering, or forced gravel.
performance_rule: Keep the speaker identity fixed. Design emotion, emphasis, pacing, and phrasing for each topic and narrative beat.
generation_policy: Generate complete passages with the same reference and model. Reject omitted, repeated, or token-limited takes. Split at meaningful narrative boundaries rather than stitching isolated sentences or rerecording an isolated ending.
decoder_policy: Preserve full waveform for explicitly unpadded batch-one generated codes; do not infer padding from internal zero codec values.
approval_limit: Speaker metrics and recognition cannot certify perceived maturity, tone accuracy or naturalness.
approval_note: The user approved the Chinese film baseline and explicitly approved english-pilot.wav on 2026-10-22. D plus body-v1 remains the series default.
